objective: Determine if a product variant with brand Heco, series 3DW-64B, model Nut Bolt and Washer, fastener type bolt, and diameter 10 mm exists in the catalogue.

params.model: lookup from product_variants WHERE model = 'Nut Bolt and Washer'
params.fastener_type: lookup from product_variant_properties WHERE property_key = 'fastener type' AND property_value_text = 'bolt'
params.diameter: lookup from product_variant_properties WHERE property_key = 'diameter' AND property_value_text = '10 mm'
params.matching_count: count of product_variants that satisfy all the above conditions
params.product: first matching product_variant row from the query
